summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1.5B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) and $592.5M in SPX 7000C (exp 2027-03-19). While heavy put buying exists at the 8000P strike, the extreme premium in long-dated calls suggests a "buy the dip" strategy for a multi-year bull run. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in the SPX 7000C strikes across 2026 and 2031 expirations, totaling billions in cumulative premium, signaling massive, non-speculative institutional positioning. Traders should watch for volatility in NVDA, AMD, and META, which all show aggressive, low P/C ratios (0.24–0.32) and heavy BuyCall dominance, suggesting immediate-term momentum plays.
